Resolves #21194

An outside contributor's unrecognized comment on an open, unclaimed curated issue now gets one short `/claim` hint linking `CONTRIBUTING.md`. A trusted receipt is keyed by repository, issue and numeric account ID, so retries and account renames do not repeat the hint. Guidance creates no ownership and a later `/claim` still follows the normal assignment path.

Evidence: L2 pure decisions and execution of the actual workflow callback with mocked GitHub I/O → L2 required for the decision and integration ACs. The first genuine hosted interaction remains the post-merge observation under #20892.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `claimResponse.spec.mjs` tests both curated labels and unrecognized offers/questions; `claimResponderPagination.spec.mjs` executes the workflow and asserts one hint, the guide link, and zero ownership writes. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: numeric-ID deduplication across repeated comments and renames; independent accounts/issues/repos; untrusted, malformed and unknown-version markers do not suppress guidance. Workflow replay retains one hint. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: guidance is absent from claim records and holders. Same-person and other-person `/claim` decisions remain assignable; the actual callback subsequently assigns the renamed original contributor. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: ineligible authors/issues/recognized comments, every assignee, existing and newer claims, and own/other resolving PRs block the hint; the own-PR control is on page two. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: six changes between snapshots suppress posting, including a new claim/hint/PR and closure; incomplete first or final reads issue no writes. Existing PR/claim/withdrawal and module-fetch cases remain in the owning specs. `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs` audits all three known contributor helpers and catches new consumers of any of them. |

## Deltas from ticket

`decideClaimHint()` lives in sibling `buildScripts/util/claimGuidance.mjs`, reusing the existing holder and identity rules from a neutral observer at the current evaluation time. This includes the author's own holders and claims newer than the queued event. The initial addition pushed `claimResponse.mjs` to 1023 code lines; extracting the new behavior keeps its cap unchanged. The workflow fetches the new module at the same defining SHA; the actual fetch/import-closure test covers it. The complete target-state reader is moved out of the PR-only branch and reused for the fresh pre-post check. Claim and withdrawal patterns and receipt markers remain separate from guidance.

Prescription checked: the pure-policy siblings own their decisions, with `claimResponse.mjs` retaining common holder/identity rules; `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` owns reads and writes. Change class: capability (`feat`). `agent-preflight` is not hosted in Engine; owning tests and syntax/hygiene checks ran locally, with the shared baseline left to CI.

The initial unit run on `7f5b3f2a` caught an omitted integration audit: the new guidance module reads the claim helper but was absent from the known-reader guard. `870e35ec72` registers that Node-only consumer and extends the scan to future readers of `claimGuidance` itself. The actual suite classifier and browser selection are unchanged. The same initial E2E run also timed out waiting for a popup in `DemoBDockTearOutNL.spec.mjs` witness 3 (shard 6); no browser source changed in this PR, and no flakiness verdict is claimed from that observation.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21194 (its `Design authority:` line first, then Contract Ledger, AC-1 to AC-5, Avoided Traps); the changed-file list; `dev`'s `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` (job guard L38-49, the `issue_comment` early return at L515-518, `concurrency: claim-responder`, `cancel-in-progress: false`) and `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` (`isClaimReply`, `isWorkflowBotComment`, `holders`); `CONTRIBUTING.md` §3; prior art in Memory Core (your diagnosis and recommendation turns; Vega's typographic-apostrophe fix to `isClaim`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** A pure decision beside the existing policy modules that takes the triggering comment, the live issue, complete comments, events and resolving PRs, and the current time. It returns a hint only for an outside human on an open, unassigned, unheld curated issue, carrying a receipt the workflow bot alone can issue, keyed by numeric ID. The workflow calls it on the unrecognized branch after complete reads, re-reads before posting, and never assigns. It must not hardcode a login as identity, must not reuse the claim receipt marker, and must not evaluate at the queued event's time. Tests: pure cases plus a replay of the real callback with mocked I/O.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. `decideClaimHint` fails closed on every malformed input and keys `<!-- claim-guidance:v1 {repo, issue, to: <numeric id>} -->`, accepted only via `isWorkflowBotComment`. It evaluates `holders()` as a neutral observer at `now`, so the commenter's own claims and PRs count, including ones newer than the event. The workflow loads state twice and posts only when the second decision still holds. AC-3's risk is closed by construction: `isClaimReply` matches only the `<!-- claim-responder:` marker, so a hint cannot read as a claim receipt.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with friction→gold: a contributor's silent comment became a bounded mechanism rather than a one-off reply. The fix also keeps the claim rules where they were (`isClaim` unchanged), so recognition has still one owner.
